title: A rotation test field with prescribed tangential divergence on a cone over a unit curve
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, orthonormal u, e ∈ ℝ^P, reals r₀, s with 0 < s < r₀, every open N ⊆ ℝ^P with ⟨x, u⟩ > 0 for x ∈ N, every γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ on (−s, s) with ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), u⟩ > 0 and arctan(⟨γ(α),e⟩/⟨γ(α),u⟩) = α for α ∈ (−s, s), every map T from ℝ^P to linear subspaces of ℝ^P with tγ(α) ∈ N and T(tγ(α)) = span{γ(α), γ′(α)} for t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), α ∈ (−s, s), and all C¹ functions λ, φ : ℝ → ℝ with compact supports, tsupport λ ⊆ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s) and tsupport φ ⊆ (−s, s): there is a C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with tsupport X ⊆ N such that, for all t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s) and α ∈ (−s, s), tr(P_{T(tγ(α))} ∘ DX(tγ(α))) = λ(t)·φ′(α)·(⟨γ(α),u⟩² + ⟨γ(α),e⟩²)/‖γ′(α)‖², where P_T is the orthogonal projection onto T.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (lam φ : ℝ → ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, t • γ α ∈ N ∧ T (t • γ α) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}) → ContDiff ℝ 1 lam → HasCompactSupport lam → tsupport lam ⊆ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo (-s) s → ∃ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ N ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((T (t • γ α)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X (t • γ α)).toLinearMap) = lam t * deriv φ α * ((inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) / ‖deriv γ α‖ ^ 2)
